_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: three signs between four small numbers, where = is easy to place; 2: × and ÷ worked left to right, or numbers to place in a given pattern; 3: four signs, a comparison (< or >), brackets, or a swap that has to be tried; 4: fractions, letters or powers. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
